projectDescription: Thea is an AI-powered Discord bot that answers member questions with citations from your own docs, runs layered AutoMod, manages tickets with triage, and publishes a searchable help center — all from one dashboard.
keyFeatures: Grounded AI answers with inline source citations — never guesses
Confidence-gated escalation hands off to human moderators when unsure
Layered AutoMod: Discord-native rules, heuristics, moderation API, and AI pass
Scam Defense with multi-signal campaign detection (links, QR codes, attachments, identity)
Raid protection with join-surge and content-storm detection
Ticket system with AI triage (category, urgency, sentiment) and routing
Searchable help center published from the same knowledge base, with custom domain support
Notion and Zendesk integrations for knowledge sync
Onboarding forms that collect answers for staff without storing member data
Activity analytics: questions, helpfulness, gaps, and time-to-answer
Playground for rehearsing real questions before going live
Content API for programmatic knowledge management (Pro and Business)
publicApiSurface: Content API (Pro/Business) — authenticate, index, and query knowledge sources programmatically
/automod test — Discord slash command to preview moderation rules against a sample message
/standing — Discord slash command for members to audit their own moderation record
/raid — Discord slash commands for manual raid control
Dashboard: knowledge sources (URL, sitemap, FAQ, Notion, Zendesk)
Dashboard: confidence threshold and escalation role settings
Dashboard: ticket routing, custom form fields, response-time targets
Dashboard: help center collections, articles, and custom domain
Dashboard: onboarding form builder (up to 5 questions, role-on-completion)
